correctness.rationale: The order-three wand symmetric boundary-law equation z=lambda((1+z)/(2z))^3 is equivalent for z>0 to Lambda(z)=8z^4/(1+z)^3. Its logarithmic derivative (z+4)/(z(1+z)) is positive everywhere, so thresholds transfer globally without a quartic root branch choice. For z<1, 3/(1+z)^2=1 gives z_-=sqrt(3)-1; for z>1, 3(z/(1+z))^2=1 gives z_+=(sqrt(3)+1)/2. Exact independent SymPy simplification yields the displayed lower 32(7sqrt(3)-12)/9 and upper 4(3+sqrt(3))/9. The source Kesten-Stigum non-extremality and sufficient extremality criteria are STRICT; equality endpoint classification remains open. No claim of other measures or parameters is made.
